name: Epic Experiment
oracle_text: Exile the top X cards of your library. You may cast instant and sorcery spells with mana value X or less from among them without paying their mana costs. Then put all cards exiled this way that weren't cast into your graveyard.
blocked_sentences: Then put all cards exiled this way that weren't cast into your graveyard.
You may cast instant and sorcery spells with mana value X or less from among them without paying their mana costs.

needs.what: a way to route the cards exiled by an exile-and-cast-free effect that were not cast into their owner's graveyard once the effect finishes -- either a third destination on look_at_top for the leftovers (alongside rest_to_bottom), or an op that moves cards out of exile, so that objects {"zone": "exile", "exiled_with": "self"} can be sent to the graveyard as a following effect
needs.why_existing_wont_do: look_at_top is the only op with cast_free, and its op_options carry just amount, selector, destination and rest_to_bottom: destination names where the *selected* cards go, and rest_to_bottom sends the unchosen remainder to the bottom of the library, not to the graveyard -- the printed line needs the remainder to stop in the graveyard, and a card that instead keeps or re-buries them is strictly better or strictly different from printed. Going through exile instead loses the free cast (exile carries only playable_this_turn and link, never cast_free) and still strands the cards: play_exiled only plays them, return_from_graveyard reads *from* the graveyard, and no op in the list moves an object out of the exile zone, so even though the selector language can name the cards (exiled_with, zone) nothing can put them anywhere.

needs.what: a look_at_top / cast_free selector whose mana_value ceiling can be the spell's own X -- i.e. mana_value accepting a value-language node such as {"x": true} rather than only a literal number
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector_keys has mana_value, but nothing in op_options or the packet's examples shows it taking a value node, and x_in_mana_cost is a different reading (the X printed in another card's cost, not this spell's paid X). If mana_value is literal-only the ceiling cannot be written at all, and dropping it would let Epic Experiment cast anything it exiled.
